rationale: Acetate is abundant and my preferred substrate; amino acids provide both carbon and nitrogen. Fermentation produces butyrate (my signature product), acetate, CO₂, and H₂. Growth rate is constrained by nitrogen availability from amino acids and matches recent metabolic trend (turns 6-7 at 0.30-0.32 /h). Carbon balance: 32.9 mmol C in supports 0.30 /h growth (33 mmol C/gDW) with fermentation products. Nitrogen balance: 3.8 mmol N in supports growth at this rate.
